description: Step 0 for a new question: which path answers it on this data. One record: route (reuse | answer | package | ask | none), a score with its reason for each of answer, package, ask and none, the compiled read plan when it is a read, the method family and the library's tool fit when it is a package, and the one question to ask when something is missing. Deterministic, read-only.
name: decide_path
